input.title: Technical Support Specialist

requirements.text: Enjoys working with and talking to clients
WordPress core, popular themes and plugins
Analytical thinking for diagnosing and solving cases
Internet protocols, email, PHP, MySQL, HTML
Direct customer communication via email, chat or phone

notes: 'To have excellent knowledge of the services' runs into the 'We expect from you' heading in the text; it is a task, so it isn't labelled.
